name_reason: Name is already fully compliant and accurate. 'data_fd2_' game-global prefix; 'shared' domain matches its sibling globals (data_fd2_shared_menu_party_roster_buffer_ptr @ 0x53BF7, data_fd2_shared_party_total_gold @ 0x53BF3); 'menu_party_member_count' correctly reflects both the data role (a count/index scalar) and the semantics (live member count of the out-of-battle menu/template party roster). No Ghidra address residue (no _53bfb-style suffix); the name carries no domain ID that needs preserving. Distinct from data_fd2_battle_party_member_count (the active per-chapter battle copy).
purpose: Live count of characters in the out-of-battle 'menu / template' party roster (the permanent recruited party held in data_fd2_shared_menu_party_roster_buffer_ptr @ 0x53BF7, 0x50-byte runtime_char slots).
logic_summary: Serves dual duty as the roster element count and the append index. New-game resets it to 0; CONTINUE/LOAD restore it from the save image (src[0xA01] in the slot, or pBuf[0x30CC] in the full engine reload); fd2_init_runtime_char_from_base_growth uses it as the append index (slot = roster_ptr + count*0x50) then increments it by 1 after filling the new recruit's slot. ~40 reader sites across menu/save/load/recruit/promotion/reorder code all index roster_ptr[i] for i in [0, count) or iterate count members. It is the menu/field-roster sibling of data_fd2_battle_party_member_count (0x30C4 in save = active battle char count; this one is 0x30CC in save).
datatype: uint32 (Ghidra undefined4; .object2 / BSS). Every store is a full-dword MOV/INC and every read uses the whole 32-bit value, so storage and access width are 32-bit even though the value range (a party member count, 0..~32) is tiny.
element_semantics: Single scalar: number of valid 0x50-byte runtime_char entries currently held in data_fd2_shared_menu_party_roster_buffer_ptr; also used directly as the index of the next slot to append.
notes: src/life/main.c comment block (lines ~750-772) is already accurate, precise, ASCII, and conclusion-form (purpose + 32-bit width rationale + writers-with-addresses + representative count/index reads + BSS zero-init note); it matches the decompilation of all writers (fd2_main_menu_continue_dispatcher @ 0x25EFA/0x26070, fd2_load_save_and_init_engine @ 0x1041E, fd2_load_state_from_selected_slot @ 0x3031F, fd2_init_runtime_char_from_base_growth INC @ 0x1144C) and readers (fd2_render_party_roster_grid, fd2_count_selected_chars, fd2_find_char_by_id_or_template, recruitment/reorder screens) -> comment_verdict=keep, no Edit to main.c. Ghidra data plate at 0x53BFB was empty (PLATE=null) -> created a concise PLATE_COMMENT summarizing the same conclusion (data plate via cu.setComment(PLATE_COMMENT,...)), Ghidra program saved. No logic concerns found: count/index semantics are self-consistent across all sites.
